blocks.text: A 30-year-old suspect, alias “Cyclone,” was arrested in a drug buy-bust operation in Barangay Ong Yiu, Butuan City on Sunday, Nov. 8, 2026.(Photo courtesy of Police Regional Office 13) SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur – Anti-narcotics operatives seized over P700,000 worth of suspected shabu from an alleged street-level drug pusher arrested in an entrapment operation in Butuan City on Sunday. Brig. Gen. Rolindo Suguilon, Police Regional Office 13 (PRO-13) director, identified the suspect as alias “Cyclone,” 30, a resident of Purok 7, Barangay Bading.
